image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rocky substrate in an intertidal zone. The chiton has a distinct oval shape with a dorsal surface covered in eight overlapping, greenish-grey calcareous plates embedded in a brownish, hairy girdle. Surrounding the chiton are various barnacles, small rocks, and patches of algae.
